message: feat(unified): U04 共同program catalog、参数schema和封存重定位
rulings: Binary schema fixes explicit code/rodata/CRT/stack GPU32 placements; container offsets are not GPU addresses. Actual frozen ELF/provider binding stays U22/U23.
Additional narrowly scoped fixture files separate loader, private-state and file-boundary tests; no model math or old binary identities changed.
Programs sharing fixed code PC are catalog entries, not simultaneously resident contexts. Release and retirement must precede loading another overlapping code object.
Permanent program pins remain during trusted read-only resident-hash verification. Public COPY cannot bypass pins or sealing; corrupted resident data quarantines with all objects retained.
Linux file-reading branch added for later matched kernel compile; host-boundary tests do not claim Linux kernel/real DMA execution.

errors.cause: u32 length comparison to UINT64_MAX always false; GCC7 Werror
errors.fix: remove redundant comparison; cast to u64 before alignment; retain pool bounds

errors.cause: PL-backed storage not guaranteed initially zero
errors.fix: explicit zero plus readback of private args/CRT/stack

errors.cause: cached program admitted by metadata without checking resident bytes
errors.fix: trusted read-only hash of resident code/rodata; quarantine retains objects on mismatch
